notes: Names: the street labelled only AVENUE running SW from West Liberty (6762,176) through Mayfield is recorded as Ross Avenue: it is collinear with the segment printed ROSS south of the E-W avenue (Ross ends at Warsaw). The long E-W street at y~1640 east of Quebec (12in sewer, 10in W pipe; printed only AVENUE, far east at x~8900) is '?' - possibly the continuation of Glenway Avenue, which is printed GLENWAY on the street running west from the Quebec/Warsaw junction at y~1778 (label at x~1200). The avenue running WSW from the Warsaw junction (6965,3470) is printed only AVENUE here; it continues west to the label ST. LAWRENCE at x~1200, y~4180, so recorded as St. Lawrence Avenue. The N-S AVENUE at x~5390 is printed SETON at its south end: Seton Avenue. RAPID and AVE. are printed on the street at x~5785 (recorded as Rapid Avenue; may be Rapid Run). AVE. at x~5888 south of St. Lawrence is printed KIRBERT at its south end. ENRIGHT printed at the south, AVE. at the north. Laclede, Carson and LaSalle are printed without suffix. Wessels: printed WESSELS on the south part and AVE. on the 40 ft north part (same alignment). The '?' street at (7120,1215) is a 40 ft street running east from Wessels to the N-S avenue at x~7342. The Quebec/Glenway/Warsaw/E-W avenue junction around (5450-5600,1700-1800) is a wide open plaza: Quebec meets the E-W avenue/Glenway line at (5562,1715); Warsaw's centreline meets Glenway at (5455,1775). Hamilton Avenue (x~5565) and Hazard (x~6130) at the bottom are printed (VACATED) and are not recorded. Not recorded (beyond x 7260): the N-S avenue at x~7342 (meets Mayfield, the y1215 street and the E-W avenue, then bends SW into Carson at ~7320,1950), and Sturm Street at x~7330. Spaced lettering (Glen Grove, G.F. Meyer's, Kuhlman's, Cynthia Terry's, Mann's, McCabes, Boyla's, Ross, Martin & ...) is subdivision names, not streets. | '?' (y ~1640) is the E-W street from the Quebec/Warsaw junction east past Ross, Kuhlman, Riolen and Wessels; printed only as 'AVENUE' (east, near x 8900); its westward continuation west of Quebec (y ~1770, Seton T) is also unnamed in my reading, and is recorded as the same '?' street. The two '?' T's on West Liberty Street (x 5287, x 5665) are streets running north off the plate top (stubs cut by the plate edge; the eastern one's label begins 'K'). 'Mayfield Avenue' east of Ross is printed only 'AVENUE'; taken as Mayfield (same line as MAYFIELD west of Ross). Glenway Avenue (y ~3500-3850) is printed only 'AVENUE' in this strip; name from the plate description, it joins Warsaw at Enright (east of there the plate prints WARSAW). Liberty west of Quebec printed 'STREET', east 'W. LIBERTY ST.'. Hamilton Avenue (x ~5525, y 5340-5830) and Hazard Street (x ~6125) are printed '(VACATED)' and are not recorded. 'GLEN GROVE', 'G.F. MEYER'S', 'KUHLMAN'S', 'CYNTHIA TERRY'S', 'ELIZ. McCABE'S', 'SEVERS' spaced lettering are subdivision names; the grey bands along them are boundaries, not streets. Middle lines drawn along Glenway, Laclede, the '?' street and Seton were used as centrelines.
